observation.visible_scene: Several glossy brown pretzels rest on or hover above a mirror-like gray surface set against a dark blue-teal background. From left to right: a pretzel that is tumbling/rotating while staying low, a short horizontal pretzel rod lying flat, a single pretzel airborne on the right, and a static pile of pretzels at the far-right edge. Each object casts a clear mirror reflection on the surface below it.
visible_changes: The left pretzel continuously rotates/tumbles in place, cycling from an edge-on diagonal bar (t=0) to a front-facing knot (t≈0.5–2.0) and back toward an edge-on tilt (t≈3.3), while its height above the surface stays roughly constant.

The right airborne pretzel rotates about a horizontal axis (edge-on → upright knot → tilted → edge-on) and its vertical position rises steadily across the excerpt, the gap between it and its reflection widening from nearly touching at t=0 to a large separation at t=3.3.
The middle horizontal rod remains essentially at rest on the surface, with only a very slight change in tilt; its reflection stays directly beneath it.
The far-right pile of pretzels stays static throughout, with its reflection unchanged.
A tiny bright speck (salt/dust) drifts near the center of the frame in several mid-excerpt frames.
The background horizon line and overall framing remain fixed, indicating no clear camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: What initiated the right pretzel's airborne rotation and upward motion, and whether it is ascending or has already begun descending beyond the crop.
Whether the left pretzel is bouncing, hovering, or rotating while in contact with the surface.
The final resting positions of the moving pretzels after the excerpt ends.
uncertain_details: Exact rotation axes of the left and right pretzels (horizontal vs. mixed) are inferred from apparent shape changes, not directly visible.
The vertical trend of the right pretzel is read as rising, but frame-to-frame oscillation cannot be ruled out.
The small bright speck's nature (particle vs. artifact) is unclear.
